architecture.title: Architecture Overview: The Determinism Wall & CQRS Separation
architecture.summary: The foundational premise: feed read path must never touch an LLM (< 50ms). CQRS separation between async content factory and Postgres read serving.

architecture.title: Generation Pipeline: LangGraph Fan-Out & Quota Governance
architecture.summary: Detailed breakdown of the LangGraph execution flow: topic planning, group-concurrent tier-sequential card generation, two-pass quality gate, and group-level persistence.

architecture.title: Content Model & Corpus Taxonomy
architecture.summary: Data contracts for Topics, Subtopics, Cards, Archetypes, and Quiz Questions. The card lifecycle and structural constraints.

architecture.title: Run 2 Benchmark: 5,004 Cards & The Concurrency Breakthrough
architecture.summary: Empirical benchmark across 40+ API keys. Eliminating the legacy semaphore bottleneck (ADR-0047) increased throughput from 16 to 130+ cards/min.

architecture.title: Run 3 Benchmark: 10,247 Cards & The Multi-Domain Scaling Milestone
architecture.summary: Five simultaneous topics, a cleaned 16-key pool, and a self-pacing quota queue push the corpus past the 10,000-card mark at 135+ cards/min.

architecture.title: Generation Pipeline v2: Grounded Drafting on Mistral
architecture.summary: The pipeline after retrieval grounding and the move off the Gemini free-tier ladder.

architecture.title: Run 8 Benchmark: Multi-Topic Marathon on the Gemini Key Grid
architecture.summary: 4,139 cards and 1,606 questions in one unattended day across 33 keys, the high-water mark of the free-tier era.

architecture.title: Benchmark 10: The First Fully Frog-Grounded Production Run
architecture.summary: 523 cards in 21m 03s at 24.85 cards/min, 2.2x the ungrounded baseline, with zero HTTP 429s.

adrs.title: ADR-0025: Batched LLM topic matching
adrs.summary: Two-stage topic deduplication: cheap local pgvector nearest-neighbor search followed by a single batched LLM classification call.

adrs.title: ADR-0026: One-shot generation to completion
adrs.summary: Idempotent topic pipeline design ensuring interrupted runs safely pick up where they left off without duplicate generation.

adrs.title: ADR-0028: Per-key-per-model quota grid with two-pool fallback ladder
adrs.summary: Transition from a flat API key list to a 2D (key × model) quota grid with independent thinking and generator fallback ladders.

adrs.title: ADR-0029: Questions join generator pool
adrs.summary: Moving question generation from the constrained thinking pool to the high-throughput generator pool.

adrs.title: ADR-0030: Two-pass, self-correcting quality gate
adrs.summary: Replacing discard-only validation with Pass 1 in-place topic/factual correction, local dedup, and Pass 2 difficulty verification.

adrs.title: ADR-0031: Verification feedback and per-tier gate durability
adrs.summary: Threading rejection feedback into subsequent generation runs and making gating durable at the subtopic-tier level.

adrs.title: ADR-0040: Serialize actual network calls per (key, model) cell
adrs.summary: Eliminating false 429 burst errors by locking same-cell network invocations while preserving full concurrency across independent grid cells.

adrs.title: ADR-0041: Per-group gate and persist
adrs.summary: Persisting cards and making them live in the feed as soon as their subtopic group finishes, removing global fan-in write bottlenecks.

adrs.title: ADR-0047: Removal of legacy concurrency semaphore
adrs.summary: Removing the obsolete global asyncio.Semaphore(5) bottle-neck and delegating all rate limiting to the multi-key QuotaGovernor.

adrs.title: ADR-0048: CockroachDB Basic over Neon, for corpus storage headroom
adrs.summary: Moving corpus storage to CockroachDB Basic ahead of Neon's 500MB free-tier ceiling, measured against real per-topic storage costs.

adrs.title: ADR-0049: No message broker in v1; Kafka is rejected, not deferred-by-accident
adrs.summary: Rejecting a Kafka-based write-decoupling proposal — the queue already lives in Postgres and the premise was never measured.

adrs.title: ADR-0050: Being shown a card consumes it; a difficulty turns over instead of running dry
adrs.summary: Fixing a feed that could show the same slate forever: an impression now marks a card deferred and actually drives the difficulty cycle forward.

adrs.title: ADR-0051: A "no color" opt-out for per-topic accent, via a sentinel hue
adrs.summary: Adding a third accent state so a topic can opt out of color tinting entirely, alongside the deterministic-default and chosen-hue states.

adrs.title: ADR-0052: A single-slot undo toast for removal in Notes/Liked/Saved
adrs.summary: A 5-second undo toast for removing notes, likes, and bookmarks, plus a cross-view store fixing stale liked/bookmarked state.

adrs.title: ADR-0087: `frog` is a sibling package that owns the embedder
adrs.summary: Retrieval moves into its own importable package that spoin depends on, never the reverse, so the boundary is structural rather than decorative.

adrs.title: ADR-0088: `the_spoin_universe` is a separate database with its own alembic environment
adrs.summary: The authored corpus lives in its own database whose migration environment never reads the production URL, so a corpus revision cannot land on user data.

adrs.title: ADR-0089: Generation is grounded in retrieved corpus context, and each card records the chunks that grounded it
adrs.summary: Both the drafter and the verifier read the same retrieved passages, and the grounding chunk IDs are stored on the card.

adrs.title: ADR-0090: A hybrid generator routes drafting calls to Mistral and keeps thinking calls on Gemini
adrs.summary: The first step off the free-tier Gemini ladder, later completed by ADR-0103.

adrs.title: ADR-0092: `Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B` at 1024 dimensions, with a GPU/CPU device split
adrs.summary: A real embedder with an asymmetric query/passage interface, replacing the 384-dimension stand-in.

adrs.title: ADR-0094: Generation and every heavy workload run locally; production hosts only the app backend
adrs.summary: Where each half of the system actually runs, and why the expensive half never touches the server.

adrs.title: ADR-0095: Cards carry real photographs from an open-licensed catalog, assigned server-side by retrieval
adrs.summary: Image assignment as a retrieval problem rather than a generation one.

adrs.title: ADR-0096: Spoin canon is pinned into the prompt per call type, never retrieved
adrs.summary: The rules the product itself guarantees are not something a similarity search gets to decide is relevant.

adrs.title: ADR-0097: One embedder, one vector space
adrs.summary: The embedder variable never reached the containers, so every stored vector was hash noise. The database was dropped and rebuilt rather than backfilled.

adrs.title: ADR-0100: `the_spoin_universe` is a claim-qualified knowledge system, not a document collection
adrs.summary: What the corpus stores is claims with their qualifications attached, which is what makes a small model able to restate instead of recall.

adrs.title: ADR-0101: The curriculum declares a tier's grounding scope, and retrieval runs once per card
adrs.summary: Grounding scope is authored alongside the curriculum rather than inferred at generation time.

adrs.title: ADR-0103: Mistral runs the thinking ladder too, and the in-flight semaphore is gone
adrs.summary: The last Gemini rung comes out of the pipeline, and the concurrency limiter it needed goes with it.
